record.body:
## Problem

The session that builds also grades. Acceptances can pass while the work-item description is unmet (dogfood: `status-tabs`). There is no independent, read-only review of the phase diff against task specs before merge.

## Approach

decide at discuss — phase-end independent reviewer subagent (GitHub #10); gaps become fix tasks via retry-loop.

## Exit criteria

- decide at plan-phase — reviewer agent, parent-recorded review check-run, fix-task routing, and a `status-tabs` regression fixture hold as verified.
